feathers.line: She is wearing rags and feathers
feathers.linePrev: And she leads you to the river

stanza: And I felt my arms
Rise light as feathers
And the clock hit me like a hammer
And my eyes rolled back like porcelain
And the breeze cooled me like aspirin
And I cried

feathers.line: But I ran out of white doves' feathers
stanza: But I ran out of white doves' feathers
To soak up the hot piss that comes from your mouth
Every time you address me
Oh, I ran out of white doves' feathers
To soak up the hot piss that comes from your mouth
Every time you address me

feathers.line: I have no bed of feathers
stanza: I have no ring for your finger
I have no banquet table to lay
I have no bed of feathers
Whatever promises I made
I can't promise you fair sky above
Can't promise you kind road below
But I'll walk beside you, love
Any way the wind blows

feathers.line: He always wore his Sunday feathers
stanza: He always wore his Sunday feathers
And held a tomahawk
The maiden wore her beads and braids
And hoped someday he'd talk
Kaw-Liga, too stubborn to ever show a sign
Because his heart was made of knotty pine

feathers.line: I think of flying down in your sea of pens and feathers
stanza: When I think of Heaven, deliver me in a black-winged bird
I think of flying down in your sea of pens and feathers
And all other instruments of faith and sex and God
In the belly of a black-winged bird
